messages.subject: Re: installation problem
messages.body_plain:
Hello, just noting that the following error seems to pop-up regardless of the version I'm trying to install (Windows 7, R 3.1):

* installing *source* package 'nimble' ...
Warning: running command 'sh ./configure.win' had status 127
ERROR: configuration failed for package 'nimble'
Warning in install.packages :
 running command '"C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-31~1.1/bin/x64/R" CMD INSTALL -l "C:\Users\John Clare\Documents\R\win-library\3.1" "C:/Users/JOHNCL~1/Desktop/nimble_0.1.tar.gz"' had status 1

Same thing regardless of whether installation is attempted remotely or locally.

Best,

John

On Saturday, August 30, 2014 4:45:44 AM UTC-4, GMarzolin wrote:
> Hi Perry:
> Now with the new version 'nimble_0.1-1.' the installation problem through Windows is solved and the package works very well. Thanks a lot.
> Gilbert.
>
>
